title: Sixers vs. Nets: Final playing status for Joel Embiid in road matchup
text:
Sixers vs. Nets: Final playing status for Joel Embiid in road matchup Rumors Stats Odds Betting Newsletter SIXERS Sixers vs. Nets: Final playing status for Joel Embiid in road matchup
 Ky Carlin Sixers Wire Nov. 16, 2026, 7:01 p.m. ET NEW YORK -- The Philadelphia 76ers will take on the Brooklyn Nets on Monday to begin a quick 2-game road trip as they move forward with their season. The Sixers are in the process of continuing to grow as a team on both ends of the floor and need to handle business against a scrappy, but rebuilding Nets team.
 Joel Embiid was listed as questionable for this contest due to a right plantar fascia injury management issue. He missed Sunday's win over the Indiana Pacers on the front end of this back-to-back, but as Philadelphia heads into this contest with the Nets, Embiid will give it a go.
 Embiid will be joined in the starting lineup by Tyrese Maxey, VJ Edgecombe, Jaylen Brown, and Dean Wade. The Sixers will sit LeBron James for this matchup after he played in Sunday's contest against the Pacers.
 Tip off from the Barclays Center is set for 7:30 p.m. EST before the Sixers head to Orlando.
